summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Bengali Aquatic Botanical Research and Infographic Encyclopedia Android App (জলজ উদ্ভিদ গবেষণা ও ইনফোগ্রাফিক বিশ্বকোষ). Includes interactive split sliders for emersed vs. submersed forms, dynamic WRGB spectrum reaction simulation, PAR/CO2 calculators, look-alike comparison matrices, deficiency pathology atlas, and complete species profiles in Bengali.
